The options set (`!strip`) disables stripping of debug symbols, which is common in binary-only packages and not inherently risky.

All aspects of this package align with standard and secure AUR packaging practices for a prebuilt binary. The sources are verifiable, the checksums are present and valid, and there is no evidence of injected code, unexpected network activity, or malicious behavior.
